title: Existence of the free extension presentation of an etale torsor
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], G an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and T a G-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor]. There exists an extension presentation of T in the sense of [def-sc-torsor-extension-presentation]: an abelian sheaf E with G -> E -> Z_X, a natural generator map from T of degree one satisfying [g+t]=[t]+g, and the universal property for maps respecting these generators and the inclusion of G. Coefficients are in Type(u+1) for X in Scheme(u).

source.place: lemma-torsors-h1 (Tag 03AJ), free abelian sheaf and pushout construction

proof.text: Sheafify the free abelian presheaves on T and on pairs (x,y) of sections of T. Define the difference map by (x,y) -> [y]-[x], and the displacement map by the unique g with g+x=y. Form their pushout with G. This constructs E and the maps from G and from the free generators; no existence theorem is used to choose its data.

source.place: lemma-torsors-h1 (Tag 03AJ), free abelian sheaf and pushout construction

proof.text: The degree map sends every torsor generator to one. Pair differences have degree zero, so the pushout supplies E -> Z_X. The sheafification unit supplies the natural generator map. The pushout relation applied to (p,g+p) gives [g+p]=[p]+g.

source.place: lemma-torsors-h1 (Tag 03AJ), free abelian sheaf and pushout construction

proof.text: A natural map from T into an abelian sheaf A extends uniquely to the free abelian sheaf. Equivariance with a given G -> A is exactly the pushout compatibility. The resulting pushout map is unique, including on the free generators since equality after the sheafification unit detects equality of sheaf maps. Thus the constructed data satisfy the extension-presentation universal property. Empty objects cause no exception to these universal properties.
